candidates.change_summary: Replace the require check so that anyone can call withdrawAll by removing the ownership requirement.
Change recipient transfer to send only half the contract balance instead of the full balance.
Invert the ownership check so that only non-owners can call withdrawAll.
Insert a check that requires the recipient to be the owner, restricting withdrawals to owner's address.
Change transfer to use call with gas forwarding and check return value instead of transfer (may alter behavior on reverts/forwarded gas).
Insert a self-destruct after transfer so contract is destroyed after withdrawal, changing subsequent observable state.
